craft: A ball of soft modelling clay being squeezed and patted into shape in the hands: three quick squishy pats and a soft pop, about 1.5 seconds
squish: Squashing a lump of soft modelling clay flat with the palm: one wet squelchy squeeze, about 1 second
plop: A soft lump of clay plopped down onto a wooden table: one short dull squishy thud, about half a second
lift: Peeling a lump of soft clay up off a wooden table: one short sticky suction pop, about half a second
rotate: A small clay figure twisted a quarter turn on a wooden turntable: one quick soft squeaky creak, about half a second
stow: A soft clay object dropped into a small cardboard box: one light papery thump, about half a second
undo: A quick soft cartoon rewind whoosh going backwards, about half a second
nope: A soft cartoon bonk on a rubber surface: one dull gentle boing, about half a second
click: A soft wooden toy button click, one short clean tap
open: A sheet of paper sliding quickly across a table: a soft swish, about half a second
shutter: A vintage film camera taking a photo: a crisp mechanical shutter click followed by a short film-advance wind, about 1 second
star: A single bright magical glockenspiel chime, one note with a soft sparkle tail, about 1 second
goal: A gentle cheerful two-note xylophone ding going up, about half a second
fanfare: A short cheerful cartoon fanfare: ukulele strum, glockenspiel run and a toy trumpet ta-da, about 3 seconds
cheer: A small group of happy children clapping and cheering yay, about 2 seconds
unlock: A tiny shop door bell jingle: two bright little bells, about 1 second
fire: A small cosy fireplace crackling softly with gentle pops and a quiet hiss, steady, about 5 seconds, seamless loop
